text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccans renew allegiance to King Hassan on the 36th anniversary of his accession to the throne.
- Morocco's golf open starts in southern city of Agadir.
- King Hassan says in speech that recent financial reforms were meant to bolster economic growth and increase investments.
- Visiting Mexican MP says his country to reconsider its position on Western Sahara.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri holds meeting with Daniel Ritchie, director for North Africa and Iran in the World Bank.
- Morocco and Spain pursue connection of electricity grids with no incident. First operations last month had led to Greenpeace demonstrations.
